rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure with no third-party involvement or vehicle involvement is straightforward property damage.
claim_summary: Windstorm damage to roof shingles on back porch overhang (4 shingles blown off, no interior water damage). Estimated repair cost $400. Claim is below the $2,500 deductible, so no coverage payout applies, but documented for record.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off by wind, no interior water damage
